name: ck12_15_step_conversion
description: Test 15 (CK8, CK9). The step is the low 32 bits of _ftol's 64-bit truncation, compared unsigned with 60 and 1200. With min -10 (SetTimeMagnificationMinMax(-10, 2000)) and magnification -5, e = 1,000,000 gives a product of -5, which wraps to a step above 1200: the clock advances by 1200 and the timer restarts. With magnification -0.5 the product truncates to 0: no step, and the timer keeps running (the elapsed time builds up). With magnification 135 and e = 0x80000000 (the unsigned-to-float idiom) the product is far above 1200: the clock advances by 1200. A NaN magnification is covered by the core's unit tests (JSON has no NaN).
